prompt: CSSFontFeatureValuesMap set method exception too many values
answer:
`CSSFontFeatureValuesMap.set()` throws an `InvalidAccessError` when the supplied value sequence contains more values than the associated feature-value block allows.

For multi-valued feature definitions, at most two values are allowed: the first identifies the feature and the second is the value passed to it. More than two values results in a syntax error or an exception when passed through `set()`. A single integer is treated as a one-value sequence.
